runner.compatibility: protocol 1.0 is the frozen, live-validated fixed full-evaluation baseline; protocol 1.1 adds target-driven outer orchestration without changing protocol 1.0 semantics

components: bench-eval-execution 3.5.51 generic skill with password-first workstation SSH and optional key onboarding for automated submission, plus per-space personal LPAI SSH access
responsibilities: use the embedded fixed-workstation access entry for SSH onboarding, one-attempt runner handshake and optional agent-forwarding verification
derive the requested products and dependency plan from this task's Job and reviewed Profile; APP, SO, configuration, dataset, scenes and scene count are variable inputs
require content identities and a new immutable run ID for every bench transaction
require a fresh bench-workstation-access/v1 READY report before submission
acquire a new APP on the submitter's personal computer, build M100 only when no SO is supplied, and directly replace the supplied sensor SO and other files
use the bench-verified /map clean-formal installer with a full old-tree backup and explicit preservation only for required runtime controls absent from the APP
derive mandatory prediction types from this task's reviewed goal and YAML; road output is required only when explicitly requested and supported by the candidate, while optional types remain audited
keep the fast path free of routine capacity and mid-transfer hash gates; report concrete install errors and verify the formal tree and service once at the end
derive eligible output frames from the reviewed replay and truth matching policy; an intentional no-truth skip is not a missing prediction
after explicit run authorization, submit each reviewed Job and relay only approvals required by its preflight plan
run Recorder stream continuously without per-scene prediction gates; verify requested workstation products after the held batch finishes, and publish or evaluate only when requested

after workstation product acceptance, create one task-level index with physical prediction and effective YAML copies under Tasks; retain immutable Cache products and receipts for existing downstream jobs, and record both paths in the index
for a reviewed multi-scene Stream Profile, hold one bench lock across the ordered batch, restore once at the end, then collect and verify the workstation product

on the reviewed hop-1 inventory ordering error, reuse a fully matching partial via an isolated fixed collection module only after formal restore and bench lock release; never replay for collection recovery

when the task requires retaining a validated package across datasets, verify actual formal-update executor and Profile support, commit the hash-identified active package once, then use_current_app for later scenes; a temporary isolated gate is not a formal commit
keep personal LPAI access in the submitter's foreground SSH agent-forwarding session
interpret JSON status, receipts, attempts and reports
must_not: let the execution workflow configure SSH, register keys, repair routes or bypass the embedded access gate
improvise bench lifecycle commands outside the reviewed Runner Profile or verified clean-formal installer and lock
transfer large predictions through the personal computer
persist personal LPAI credentials or private keys on the shared workstation
turn a downstream transfer or evaluation retry into another replay

responsibilities: persist jobs, approvals, plans, events, receipts and attempt evidence
plan protocol 1.1 dependencies from requested targets and supplied products
maintain FIFO queue order for bench work and run non-bench work without claiming bench.lock
report read-only workstation, bench-link and lock diagnostics
serialize access to the shared bench only when required
execute approved profile adapters and validate restoration or an explicitly approved formal activation
store the team-shareable authoritative prediction product
optionally publish predictions to the submitter's LPAI space
run profile-approved LPAI evaluation commands in immutable attempts and collect reports
return stable machine-readable status
must_not: reuse one user's LPAI session for another user
overwrite failed evaluation attempts or partial truth transfers

compatibility.protocol_1_0: accepted only by the compatible fixed-chain executor, with FULL_COMPLETED semantics and no cross-attempt evaluation reuse
compatibility.protocol_1_1: required for workflow.targets, supplied prediction sources and COMPLETED_TO_REQUESTED_GOAL semantics; it cannot be routed to full-evaluation
compatibility.mismatch_action: block before persisting or executing remote mutations

queue_boundary.ready_state: queued and eligible after preflight and all dynamically required approvals
queue_boundary.cancellation: allowed before bench claim and never deletes evidence
queue_boundary.profile_transaction: job selects command_set_id only; reviewed commands stay in the workstation profile
queue_boundary.target_workflow: protocol 1.1 executor runs the reviewed replay, transfer and evaluation path; APP acquisition, optional M100 build and clean-formal installation are separate fixed tools in this project
queue_boundary.dynamic_bench_lock: the worker recomputes requires_bench from immutable job.json plus the selected Profile; plan.workflow.requires_bench is audit metadata and any mismatch blocks before executor, SSH or bench.lock operations
queue_boundary.non_bench_concurrency: a recomputed non-bench target may proceed while the bench is occupied
queue_boundary.unsafe_restore_policy: retain bench.lock and block every later bench run
queue_boundary.formal_update_policy: only an immutable protocol 1.1 plan with workflow.bench_strategy=formal_update may retain hash-verified active inputs; failures before verified commit restore once

approval_boundary.rule: approval requirements come from the resolved plan, not from a fixed global list

diagnostic_boundary.fixed_workstation: ubuntu-workstation at 192.0.2.10:22 for bench-user, with a pinned ED25519 host fingerprint
diagnostic_boundary.personal_computer: OpenSSH presence, alias, identity file, host trust, authentication and runner handshake
diagnostic_boundary.workstation: controller return route, sshd, bench interfaces, route, neighbor, TCP 22 and bench lock
diagnostic_boundary.automatic_local_setup: allowed only after explicit authorization; create a per-computer key, back up SSH config, write one managed block and immediately re-verify
diagnostic_boundary.blocker_action: stop before package staging, activation or replay

data_plane.authoritative_product: hash-verified workstation prediction inventory with an adjacent producer receipt
data_plane.supplied_product_rule: producer_run_id, current inventory, inventory SHA-256 and product identity must match the receipt before a supplied workstation product is used
data_plane.legacy_product_rule: legacy workstation products require an explicit HOP1_VERIFIED evidence-matching backfill; directory presence and automatic scans are not trust signals
data_plane.optional_lpai_route: workstation shared product -> submitter's personal LPAI directory
data_plane.resume_boundary: publication and evaluation resume from the workstation product without replay
data_plane.lpai_auth: per-user SSH agent forwarding from the personal computer; pause when interactive authorization or paid instance start is required
data_plane.truth_readiness: partial/layout markers, empty truth and manifest mismatches block before run.sh
data_plane.evaluation_validity: process exit, nonzero candidate/completed frames and required task coverage are separate gates
data_plane.evaluation_attempts: failed or interrupted aNNN evidence is retained; retry allocates the next attempt and remote run id
data_plane.release_boundary: production current is 1.8.2 by prior user authorization; it is not switched automatically and older releases remain rollback baselines
